We’re not waiting for the doors of an impossibly chic new designer store to open - we’re lining up patiently to be allowed into… Zara. Yesterday Zara launched what could be the most expensive high street collaboration yet - RE(form) Zara, designed by couturier John Galliano. Prices range from £16.99 for a scarf to £699 for an evening dress. And since Galliano is one of the biggest and most controversial names in fashion, the launch (in just two stores, in Bond Street and Madrid) has been shrouded in secrecy. The excitement among my fellow queuers is palpable. As my neighbour in the line puts it: ‘He may not be the nicest person, but this collection is amazing.’ It’s a loaded statement, but one that rather neatly sums up the strange fascination surrounding the 65-year-old British designer.
